policies.with_check:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM auto_accounts a
  WHERE (a.id = auto_account_logs.account_id))) AND ((campaign_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM auto_campaigns c
  WHERE ((c.id = auto_account_logs.campaign_id) AND ((c.account_id = auto_account_logs.account_id) OR (c.secondary_account_id = auto_account_logs.account_id)))))))
